        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_StrategicReview</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Finance" name="Finance">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_FinanceReview</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_AllocateBudget</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Stakeholders" name="Stakeholders">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ApproveAdjustment</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <!-- Flow nodes -->
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_1" name="Process start" />

    <bpmn:task id="Task_OutlineObjectives"
               name="Outline objectives for upcoming period" />

    <bpmn:task id="Task_DraftPlan"
               name="Draft plan with cost estimates and justifications" />

    <bpmn:task id="Task_StrategicReview"
               name="Review plan in strategic alignment meeting" />

    <bpmn:task id="Task_FinanceReview"
               name="Finance department performs detailed review" />

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AdjustmentNeeded"
                           name="Adjustment required?" />

    <!-- Loop path (adjustments) -->
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DocumentAdjustment"
               name="Document adjustment" />

    <bpmn:task id="Task_ApproveAdjustment"
               name="Approve adjustment" />

    <!-- Continue path -->
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AllocateBudget"
               name="Allocate budget to department" />

    <bpmn:task id="Task_ImplementPlan"
               name="Implement plan" />

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_1" name="Process end" />

    <!-- Sequence flows -->
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_1" targetRef="Task_OutlineObjectives" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_2" sourceRef="Task_OutlineObjectives" targetRef="Task_DraftPlan" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_3" sourceRef="Task_DraftPlan" targetRef="Task_StrategicReview" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_4" sourceRef="Task_StrategicReview" targetRef="Task_FinanceReview" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_5" sourceRef="Task_FinanceReview" targetRef="Gateway_AdjustmentNeeded" />

    <!-- Decision: Yes (adjustment) -->
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Yes" name="yes" sourceRef="Gateway_AdjustmentNeeded" targetRef="Task_DocumentAdjustment">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression"
                                xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">adjustmentNeeded</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_6" sourceRef="Task_DocumentAdjustment" targetRef="Task_ApproveAdjustment" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_7" sourceRef="Task_ApproveAdjustment" targetRef="Task_FinanceReview" />

    <!-- Decision: No (proceed) -->
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_No" name="no" sourceRef="Gateway_AdjustmentNeeded" targetRef="Task_AllocateBudget">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression"
                                xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">!adjustmentNeeded</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_8" sourceRef="Task_AllocateBudget" targetRef="Task_ImplementPlan" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_9" sourceRef="Task_ImplementPlan" targetRef="EndEvent_1" />
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
